bio: Robert Kegan's research helped pioneer the field of adult development. Building on this research, he and HGSE colleague Lisa Lahey, created a deliberate practice  the immunity to change approach  which helps people make lasting improvements by overcoming limiting mindsets.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
